trips.name: Zhovkva (Žovkva)
trips.description: A UNESCO-listed Renaissance 'ideal town' about 30 km north of Lviv, with a fortified castle, the Grand Synagogue ruins and the wooden Holy Trinity church, reached by frequent marshrutka from Lviv's bus stations.

trips.name: Olesko Castle
trips.geocode_query: Olesko Castle, Olesko, Lviv Oblast, Ukraine
trips.description: A hilltop 13th-century castle and birthplace of King Jan III Sobieski, housing a Lviv Art Gallery branch with paintings and sculpture, and usually combined with nearby Pidhirtsi and Zolochiv castles on organized day tours (or reached by bus from Lviv's Stryiskyi/Pidzamche bus stations).

trips.name: Zolochiv Castle
trips.geocode_query: Zolochiv Castle, Zolochiv, Lviv Oblast, Ukraine
trips.description: A well-preserved 17th-century palace-fortress ensemble with the Chinese Palace and Great Palace, about 65 km east of Lviv and easy to reach by suburban train or bus.
